summary: Backend + Frontend tested for Sales Dashboard & Reports (analytics summary extensions + /admin/reports/* CSV export + schedule CRUD + mocked send-now). 13/13 pytest tests pass. UI renders TodayStrip, KPI delta pills, revenue chart current bars, 168-cell heatmap, top items with images + trend pills, category donut, export dialog with working CSV download, and full schedule lifecycle (create → send-now → toggle → delete) with success toasts.
critical_code_review_comments: revenue-prev-{i} is rendered only when b.previous > 0 (AdminAnalytics.js L202). With no data in the previous period, paired prev bars don't render at all. Functionally correct, but spec says 'paired bars' — consider rendering a 0-height prev bar (or a min-height placeholder) to always pair with revenue-curr-{i} for visual consistency and easier testing.
analytics.py bucket index computation uses integer division on span_seconds which can produce off-by-one for sub-day ranges on the edges; minor but not causing failures in current data set.

reports.py _paid_orders uses ISO string range comparisons. Works because created_at is stored as ISO UTC strings with consistent format. Document this invariant or switch to real datetime storage to avoid future timezone bugs.
send-now is correctly flagged MOCKED (returns mocked:true, logs only). Confirmed no real email dispatch — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Test created a schedule during lifecycle test (revenue/daily → TEST_qa_ui@example.com) and cleaned up via DELETE. pytest also creates+deletes sched_* docs. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All sales dashboard endpoints (/api/admin/analytics/summary with new today+previous_period+heatmap+enriched top_items, /api/admin/reports/export orders|revenue|items, /api/admin/reports/schedules CRUD, /send-now MOCKED) are fully working. UI at /admin/analytics renders all required data-testids: today-strip, today-orders/revenue/aov/mix-*, kpi-*-delta, revenue-curr-*, peak-hours-heatmap with 168 heatmap-cell-{d}-{h} cells carrying data-value, top-item-*, category-donut + donut-legend-*, export-dialog with export-type-*/export-start/export-end/export-download-btn, report-scheduler with schedule-create-form, schedule-row-{id}, schedule-send-now/toggle/switch/delete. Note: revenue-prev-{i} bars only render when b.previous > 0 — in current seeded data this is never true, so those testids are absent from the DOM (intentional per implementation; not a bug). MOCKED flow: POST /admin/reports/schedules/{id}/send-now only logs + updates last_sent_at, no real email sent.
